title: "F-PHE — Password-hardened encryption, threshold, key rotation"
status: "Canonical"

*F-PHE* (Password-hardened encryption, threshold, key rotation) is part of *Public-Key Primitives, Key Exchange, Messaging* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

A recently introduced category, adjacent to *F-MHF* — the one recent functionality that touches password hashing. The paper introducing it also reports a flaw in the proof of an earlier threshold construction.

*References:*

- Abdolmaleki et al. [*Universally composable password-hardened encryption*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2025/1647). Cryptology ePrint Archive, Paper 2025/1647, 2025.
